name: interactivebrokers
_comment: Interactive Brokers' own Bootstrap modal (#cookie-modal; user reports interactivebrokers.com and .ie 2026-10-14). Refuse is #gdpr-reject-all ('Reject All Cookies'). Both buttons POST the choice and reload the page, so the extension's 'done' is lost with the reload; the canary checks 'clear'. Verified 2026-10-17 on .ie: the POST carries perf/func/targ=false. The .com banner did not show from a Czech IP.
